cards.text: John is the one writing Revelation (Revelation 1:9), and he's just been told how the kings and merchants of the earth will weep over the fall of Babylon the great (Revelation 18:2, 9-11). After this, John hears a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven. My Mags was the loudest voice in the whole Millers' kitchen, and friend, she would not stand a CHANCE against this.

cards.question: Just like the kings and merchants of the earth, the voices John hears in heaven are weeping over Babylon.

cards.text: Not even close. They're shouting, "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!"

cards.question: The voices in heaven give a reason for all that praise. What is it?

answers.text: His judgments are true and just
The kings have made peace with Him
The merchants have turned back to Him

cards.text: They say He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. That's Babylon the great (Revelation 17:5, 18), and her hand poured out the blood of His servants.

cards.question: The voices in heaven say God has ___ the blood of His servants that Babylon poured out.
After that, the voices in heaven are done shouting.

cards.text: Nope. A second time they call out: "Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever."
Then the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures get their turn. They're the ones around God's throne (Revelation 4:4, 6).

cards.question: What do the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures do?

answers.text: Stand at a distance and weep

cards.text: And all they say is "Amen, Hallelujah!" Friend, I have never said ANYTHING in two words in my whole life.

cards.question: Then a voice comes from the throne, calling for praise to our God. Who does it call to praise Him?

answers.text: All who serve and fear Him

cards.question: The voice from the throne calls for praise from everyone who serves God, the great and the ___ alike.

cards.text: Then John hears a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder. My little oven timer could NEVER.

cards.question: These voices cry out Hallelujah too, and they give a reason. What is it?

answers.text: The Lord our God the Almighty reigns
The Lord our God has gathered the nations
The Lord our God has opened the heavens

cards.text: Then they say, "Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory." And then they say why, and friend, my mustache is already trembling.

cards.question: Right after "Let us rejoice and be glad," what do the voices say has come?

cards.text: The marriage of the Lamb! The Lamb is Jesus, God's Son (John 1:29, 34), and baker, THIS is what I've been filling cookie boxes for.

cards.question: A wedding needs a bride. The voices say the Lamb's bride has made herself ___.

cards.text: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure. Meanwhile, my apron has had the same chocolate chip smudge on it since Tuesday.

cards.question: That bright and pure fine linen means something. What is the fine linen the bride wears?

answers.text: The righteous acts of the saints
The riches of the great city
The prayers of the twenty-four elders

cards.question: Then the angel tells John to write something down. Who does the angel say are blessed?

answers.text: Those invited to the marriage supper
Those seated closest to the throne
Those who kept watch through the night

cards.text: "Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb." Invited, friend, which is exactly how a worn-out stamper got pulled out of the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: After telling John to write, the angel says these are the true words of God.

cards.text: So John falls at the angel's feet to worship him. Now, I fall flat on my face too. Into the chocolate chips. On PURPOSE. Twice before breakfast.

cards.question: When John falls at his feet, the angel lets John worship him.

cards.text: The angel says, "Do not do that!" Then he tells John what he really is.

cards.question: After stopping John from worshiping him, what does the angel call himself?

cards.text: A fellow servant with John and his brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Same kitchen, same apron, friend.

cards.question: Instead of letting John worship him, the angel tells John to worship ___.

cards.text: Then he adds, "For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy." And friend, if an ANGEL won't take worship, this stamper on a gold base is DEFINITELY not taking any.
